svg.title: Unlimited receiver windows
svg.desc: The decoder's slot events for "Hi!~" at 6 bytes/s at 20 dB and at the gate: START and STOP bars, the reference line between them, the decision line (the adaptive line, the default) and the data bars.
svg.text: What the receiver sees: each window's reference and decision lines (spec 3.5)
"Hi!~" at 6 bytes/s through a USB channel: the decoder's own slot events, in % of the running reference.
Purple: START/STOP; teal: a 1; gray: a 0; dashed: the reference line; amber: the decision line (adaptive, the default).
SNR set 20.0 dB (key-down tone in 2500 Hz); measured by the receiver at the lock: 19.6 dB
the provisional gate (1.3 dB) at 6 bytes/s
SNR set 1.3 dB (key-down tone in 2500 Hz); measured by the receiver at the lock: 0.7 dB
Each window carries its own reference, its START and STOP levels: a fade across the window tilts both lines alike.
Near the gate a 0 may reach up towards the line and a 1 dip towards it: the decoder flags a bit within 12.5 % of its line as weak.
